description:

 a— a strategic intelligence scenario framework for EU R&I with a set of scenarios that will serve as context in the strategic analysis of relevant trends,
 b— a methodology and indicators for signposting, identifying and monitoring relevant emerging trends,

title: Multi-beam lidars
description: Předmětem veřejné zakázky je dodání víceřádkovch lidarů. Lidar je laserový senzor, který měří vzdálenost okolních objektů vysíláním laserových pulzů a měřením doby do jejich návratu. Laser je připevněn na rotující základně, čímž je dosaženo horizontálního zorného úhlu 360°. Víceřádkový lidar měří vzdálenost ve více měřicích rovinách (kanálech), čímž je zajištěno 3D pokrytí prostoru. Míra pokrytí ve 3D je definována vertikálním zorným úhlem. Senzor bude upevněn na mobilní robotické platformy používané ve výzkumných projektech se zaměřením na pátrání a záchranu. Data ze senzoru budou využity převážně pro lokalizaci, mapování, analýzu průjezdnosti, plánování pohybu, navigaci, vyhýbání se překážkám, automatické řízení pohyblivých částí robotů a pro detekci objektů. Wide field-of-view lidars for aerial robots (drones): Předmětem plnění 1. části veřejné zakázky je dodávka Lidarů s širokým zorným úhlem pro drony. Wide field-of-view lidars for ground robots: Předmětem plnění 2. části veřejné zakázky je dodávka Lidarů s širokým zorným úhlem pro pozemní roboty. Long-range lidar for ground robot: Předmětem plnění 3. části veřejné zakázky je dodávka Lidaru s dlouhým dosahem pro pozemní robot. Awardee: Ouster, Inc.

title: KA-BAND ANTENNA ARRAY SUBSYSTEM FOR LAUNCHERS COMMUNICATION VIA DATA RELAY
description: The current TM link between the launcher and ground is done through the different ground station depending on the specific trajectory. These ground stations services are costly. A lower cost alternative would be to use a Relay System such as EDRS, but for this purpose a K-band antenna is needed to be installed. As the K band presents a bigger attenuation than the current S band a low profile,K band array is needed to increase the gain and cope with the losses. In order to maintain the link while the launcher is rotating it is necessary to constantly point the array towards the Relay satellite. The system design needs to be robust and independent fromthe launcher central computer, in order to maintain the communication in the event of a major problem of the launcher. The pointingcontrol function is therefore preferred to be implemented inside the communication subsystem. The design options for the control function are to be evaluated at the beginning of the activity (e.g. use of GNSS signal and/or passive retrodirective pointing using forward link beacon signal). The design is aimed at covering all the requirements of a launcher external element including the low profile, extreme mechanical and thermal conditions taking into account the thermal dissipation, and the typical TED (Thermo-Elastic Distortion). The activity also studies the end to end link system design (including link budget), to have a robust link with continuousconnection during the complete trajectory, leading to definition of key design elements including antenna gain, size, number of elements, RF losses, bandwidth, transmit RF power, data rates and associated modulation and coding to be used. The modulation and coding is to be in compliance with relevant standards and compatible with Data Relay systems in Ka-Band. The critical functions breadboarding is to include the representative elements to prove the complete system, including at least Ka-Band phased array elements and pointing control. The test results on performance of the antenna subsystem are fed into a final analysis on the end-to end system performance and robustness, to confirm the system design. This activity encompasses the following tasks:- Requirements Review and Consolidation- Preliminary Design- Breadboard implementation- Breadboard testing- Way forward towards development to reach flight model and recommendation on remaining onboard elements to be developed/completed

title: Consulting Introduction of MPEG Audio, Digital Radio, and Satellite Communication Technologies India
description: As part of the international exploitation of the technology portfolio of the Audio and Media Technologies (AME) division, as well as the associated application technologies related to digital radio, television, streaming, and satellite communications, the IIS conducts market and business development in the Asian region with a particular focus on India and other countries in the region. This involves the following tasks: • Supporting major broadcasters, AV content providers such as OTT streaming platforms, and software and hardware providers such as transmitter/receiver manufacturers, automotive and mobile phone industry regarding the implementation and use of the latest audio and application technologies in the AME division. Specifically, this primarily involves the further establishment of the AME audio codecs xHE-AAC and MPEG-H 3D Audio and its successors, which are specified in standards such as Digital Radio Mondiale (DRM) and ATSC 3.0, as well as AME’s associated applications and technologies in India and geographically close markets. • Supporting the market research, development for non-terrestrial, in particular satellite-based, voice services, especially supporting the launch of the NESC speech codec technology and its successors. • The scope of activities includes communication with and visits to authorities, standardization organizations and committees, industry and interest groups, and companies; the presentation of technology demonstrators for parts of or the entire transmission chain; the preparation, implementation, and follow-up of trade fairs; and negotiations with broadcasting institutions and industry decision-makers. • Representing Fraunhofer IIS and participating in local standardization activities and engaging with relevant regulatory bodies/committees, including the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS), Telecommunications Standards Development Society, India (TSDSI), and further coordinating with in-house experts. • Argumentation and persuasion are required at the level of engineering, management and authorities. • Continuous maintenance of the personal network with the efficient use of time and financial resources is expected. In addition, reliable market figures and competitive analyses are required as a basis for decision-making to align strategic product planning with the requirements of the industry. Find more information in the Tender Specification

title: CNECT/2022/OP/0049 – Participatory Foresight on Next Generation Online Platforms
description: The tender involves the organisation of a foresight exercise into next-generation online platforms and their transformative impacts on the EU's society and economy. The work shall identify emerging trends and develop scenarios for the online platform economy, including from a global perspective. It shall organise dives on specific trends. Technological developments such as virtual/augmented reality, metaverse, sectoral developments in areas such as energy, health and manufacturing as well as concentration of economic power driven by digitisation efficiencies will be investigated. The changing role of the firm and the position of EU SMEs in B2B industrial supply chains should be investigated. This work shall help inform future policy work including for upcoming Commission mandates. It is linked to the Digital Businesses indicator in the Digital Decade. It shall aim to aid EC colleagues’ foresight literacy and help cross-fertilise horizontal platform policy and sectoral policy areas.
